subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do all religions demand harsh punishment for crime?
items.correct: No — many emphasise justice alongside forgiveness, mercy and reform.
items.why: Believers balance justice with mercy, and views on punishment differ widely.

items.q: Do all religious believers support the death penalty?
items.correct: No — views differ widely, even within the same religion.
items.why: Believers reach a range of conclusions on capital punishment.

specSource: AQA GCSE Religious Studies A specification; Theme E: Religion, Crime & Punishment
